reasons: A1: No matched quality comparison, verified finding accuracy or measured improvement is supplied. Utility tests are not AI quality outcomes.
A2: Domain adaptation and deterministic/model separation are specific design contributions, but deployment, originality relative to alternatives and comparative benefit remain unsubstantiated.
A3: Two reported quarters, reusable prompts and observed local versioning controls support continuity in principle; longitudinal adoption and adaptation outcomes are absent.
A4: The 257-day and nested monthly-task claims are coherently scoped, but source digests do not verify calculations, approvals, costs or maintained quality.
A5: The assurance task provides a reported operational benefit, without verified stakeholder outcomes, accessibility corrections or satisfaction evidence.
editorial_fixes: “Review time is included in the calculation” is ambiguous beside net savings. Replace with “The reported released effort is net of human review time; operating and maintenance costs have not been included in a verified cost comparison.” This clarifies the stated calculation without asserting unknown costs were deducted.

“The documented development approach adapts Phi-4” can read as verified implementation. Replace with “The technical documentation describes adapting Phi-4 for accessibility using QLoRA.” Retain the following limitation on serving provenance.

“For service users” introduces intended benefits without observed user results. Replace that opening with “The specialist applications address potential service-quality risks”. Keep the explicit final acknowledgement that measured quality evidence is missing; do not manufacture an outcome.
missing_evidence: Package now: S01 as an attributed narrative digest; A01–A07 as dated local interface illustrations only; A08 as synthetic utility verification; A09 as adverse dataset-integrity evidence. Neither hashes nor repeated review verify client achievements.

Acquire the original task ledger, review deductions, quarterly approval provenance and bounded monthly-task samples; a matched quality baseline and follow-up; operating/maintenance costs if claiming financial reduction.

Acquire model/training/serving provenance and independently reviewed comparative evaluation. The 112 deduplicated candidates are not a validated holdout. Define the 85% numerator, denominator, period and AI versus rule contribution; obtain stakeholder or verified correction outcomes.

reasons: N1: Thresholds and volume achievement are concrete, but the supplied response-time example fails and has four observations per transaction; requirements closure is absent.
N2: Production-informed design, scaling profiles and abnormal cache reproduction are relevant. Actual transaction mix, production comparability and sufficiently sampled execution remain unverified.
N3: Failure detection and narrated readiness inputs establish a plausible contribution, without traceable retests, acceptance records or release decisions.
N4: Goals, tools and activities are specific. Neither savings calculations nor successful requirement/remediation results are independently substantiated.
N5: Telemetry gaps, rebuilds, exit-state failures and cache reproduction have concrete responses. Gate effectiveness, recovery and durable remediation still need execution records.
editorial_fixes: “These validate the tooling that processes performance evidence” overstates the uninspected 285-test source claim. Replace with “The narrative describes these as tooling regression tests, rather than client performance scenarios; their raw execution output is not attached.”

“The framework has been applied to AKS migration programmes and contributed to the client’s wider performance testing strategy” is unqualified despite narrative-only evidence. Replace with “The supplied narrative reports application to AKS migration work and contribution to the client’s performance testing strategy.”

“The source’s separate production-volume label uses an unresolved baseline and is not used here” exposes source-review mechanics without adding a submission result. Delete that sentence; retain N01’s explicit unresolved-baseline warning in the evidence pack and the paper’s transaction-mix/environment/sample caveat.
missing_evidence: Package now: N01 as a derived, visually checked transcription of workload and failed alert visuals; N02–N04 as source-attributed narrative digests. Retain four-sample limitation, 7/64 telemetry availability and distinction between tooling tests and client scenarios. Withhold confidential original visuals and email image.

Acquire an agreed requirements-to-run matrix, production traffic/workload and environment comparison, adequately sampled passing retests, reconciled endpoint aggregates, defect closure and migration/release acceptance records.

Acquire paired cache measurements with equivalent workload/duration, telemetry-gate reruns and raw tooling-test output. Verify each 90% activity saving with comparable timings including review and exceptions. Incident windows are needed only if restoring a post-release incident outcome claim.

reasons: I1: The contribution model plausibly improves internal practice, but duplicate-maintenance reduction, coverage improvement and active adoption are not measured.
I2: The ownership bottleneck, tagging, template utility and three pipeline roles are described concretely. Inspected implementation and matching execution records are missing.

I3: A transferable internal adaptation is articulated, but no substantiated boundary-pushing attempt or comparative contribution demonstrates an industry advance. External adoption is one possible route, not a mandatory condition.
I4: Goals and responsibilities are clearer after scope narrowing. Five-team participation and delivered assets remain narrative claims without verified outcomes.
I5: Ownership maintenance, setup consistency and triage have plausible design responses, but no completed failure-to-owner-to-retest example demonstrates resolution.
editorial_fixes: “A central team still governs execution, but it no longer has to re-author every service’s business-critical scenario” presents an achieved benefit. Replace with “The design retains central execution governance while allowing service-owned scenarios to be reused without a second platform copy.”

“A formal test strategy defines the approach” is not backed by an inspected strategy. Replace with “The supplied narrative describes a formal test strategy defining service maintenance and platform execution responsibilities.”

“The source gives inconsistent scopes for setup timing” can be removed from the submission while retained in S02. Replace the paragraph with “No quantified onboarding saving is claimed. A like-for-like timing comparison would need to cover the same preparation steps and validation effort.”
missing_evidence: Package now: S02 as an anonymised design/adoption digest, explicitly distinct from inspected source code, pipeline history and certified timing. AI screenshots and account savings are correctly excluded from innovation results.
Acquire implementation files, approved strategy, contributions and shared-run records for each reported team, a completed triage/retest chain, and comparable setup timings.

Acquire baseline/current regression coverage or duplicate-maintenance results, with resources and observation period. For I3, substantiate a specific attempt to exceed prevailing practice using a comparative technical or organisational account; documented external uptake may support this but is not the sole route.

council_recommendation: Evidence substantiation has plateaued: AI 8/25, NFT 12/25, innovation 10/25. Writing is substantially improved; no paper defensibly reaches 4/5 on every criterion. The derived pack improves attribution and confidentiality, not client-result verification. Account AI, specialist local development, PerfOps/Perf Insights and shared regression are now substantially better separated; establish the organiser-facing nomination boundary privately. Keep the monthly coverage saving inside 257 days and do not transfer NFT or shared-regression outcomes to AI. Correct the limited residual editorial overstatements, then acquire primary records rather than commission further cosmetic scoring passes. Supply organiser-required third-party identity separately and privately.
